fusions.name: Overripe Cap
fusions.desc: Throws a spore pod that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%).

fusions.name: Puffball Underfoot
fusions.desc: Puffs a cloud of spores 4 tiles ahead that deals 10 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Fruiting Bodies
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles rots where it lies for 8 seconds. Enemies within 4 tiles of it take 4 damage a tick and [Rot] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaned Decay
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
